renderings.kjv: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved

elsewhere.note: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and…
Also pull out some for her from the bundles, and leave it. Let her glean, and don’t rebuke her.”
You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters: but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains…
Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who makes himself a prophet to you,
He rebukes the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan languishes, and Carmel; and the flower of Lebanon languishes.
Yahweh said to Satan, “Yahweh rebuke you, Satan! Yes, Yahweh who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”
Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.
